messages:
maria_cs: Heads-up — Lumenly's intake returned a security packet with some KMS/BYOK asks. They specifically want: proof of BYOK support, key rotation cadence logs, and confirmation of where embeddings are stored (residency). Here's the form they uploaded: <https://drive.redwood/example-lumenly-form>
Dylan_se: quick q — do we consider non-prod keys (staging/dev) in the same SOC2 scope for evidence they requested?
sophia_privacy: for this customer we've historically scoped SOC2 evidence to production data flows only. non-prod logs we don't provide as part of standard evidence unless there's a contractual need. @nate_security can confirm if we have a redacted sample for rotation logs we can share.
onboarding-bot: [status] intake document received • auto-classify: vendor-risk-form • assigned: maria_cs • due: in 48h
nate_security: We can supply a clear attestation: 
- Hosted: our KMS (HSM-backed) — we cannot offer BYOK. 
- Private (VPC/on‑prem): we support customer-managed keys (BYOK).
We also have rotation events monthly and full audit trails. I'll prepare a redacted rotation log and an attestation statement.
dylan_se: perfect. Customer's blocker is "who can access the key material" — can we provide a short plain-English statement about privileged access & separation of duties?
nate_security: Yes. We limit key access via KMS policies and IAM roles; ops does not have plaintext key export. Audit logs stored in immutable storage. I'll draft a 1-paragraph statement. ETA: EOD tomorrow.
maria_cs: They also asked how long embedding vectors are kept for hosted users — default retention is 90 days, can be configurable for Dedicated/Private. Sophia — want me to call that out in the packet?
sophia_privacy: yes, call out defaults + options. Also include data residency options (US, EU regions) and that we can provide an export of data flow diagrams for SOC2 if they need more granularity. Link to residency page: <https://docs.redwood/infrastructure/residency>
dylan_se: i'll assemble the evidence packet. Need: (1) sample rotation log (redacted) (2) the 1-paragraph access attestation (3) residency map + retention statement. If @nate_security drops the log and paragraph here i can stitch and send to the CSM.
nate_security: dropping a redacted sample below — obviously placeholder values removed:
```csv
date,rotation_id,initiator
2025-11-01,rot-1234,infra-rotation-bot
2026-02-01,rot-2345,se-vault
```
nate_security: draft attestation (short): "Redwood Inference uses HSM-backed key management for hosted customers; plaintext key material is never exportable to personnel. Access to KMS operations is restricted by IAM roles and logged to an immutable audit trail. For Private deployments, customers may provide keys via supported BYOK flows and retain exclusive control over key material."
maria_cs: this is great — i'm scheduling a 30m walkthrough with Lumenly tomorrow 10:00am PT to go over the packet and answer questions. @dylan_se @nate_security can you join? i'll send calendar invite now.
dylan_se: i'll be there. will bring a one-page FAQ for the call.
sophia_privacy: i'll try to join for the residency/retention bits, if i can't i'll review the packet pre-call.
maria_cs: thanks all :thumbsup: i'll post the final packet here after the call and note any follow-ups.
